items.evidence: Log shows 48 p1000 pick-up/drop cycles, each aspirating 250 uL from a distinct tube into a distinct odd-column well (A1..H11), and each column is eluted to the same-position well in the elution plate.
Log: 40 uL beads (lines 30-71), then 2x125 uL isopropanol, then 250 uL samples with 5x300 uL mixes; delay 300 s, engage, delay 240 s, then 3x180 uL supernatant removal to waste plate with magnet on.
Two washes of 3x166.667 uL ethanol (A9/A10 and A11/A12) each fully removed to waste with magnet engaged, then delay 240 s and disengage before elution.
Log lines 1192-1213 aspirate 100 uL from the extraction plate into the elution plate, not about 80 uL as specified; otherwise elution/mix/30 s/engage/90 s sequence is present.

Step order and reagent identities match the paper (beads, isopropanol, sample, 70% ethanol x2, dry, elution), and the comments match what the code does; extra bead-reservoir mixes are minor and do not alter the steps.

judge.summary: The protocol faithfully implements binding, magnet, two ethanol washes, drying and elution timings with correct per-sample tips and traceable wells. It fails the elution recovery item because it transfers 100 uL of eluate rather than about 80 uL.
